scope: Corollary 6.6 (Fair-insertion message) of the manuscript “A Pivotal Amplitude for Voronoi Percolation from Cardy's Formula” (preprints/A-Pivotal-Amplitude-for-Voronoi-Percolation-from-Cardys-Formula-October-5-2026/voronoi-pivotal-amplitude.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 224 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 50c54704fe210d89), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are 0 < ν < 1 and C < ∞ such that the following holds. Insert a nucleus at the center of a cut, with an independent fair color. At a seam of radius s, take the difference of the inside state laws “with this insertion” minus “without this insertion,” conditional on the seam and with its screen success imposed. Its message Is satisfies ∥Is∥s ≤ Cs−2−ν (6.23) for all sufficiently large s. The estimate remains valid in the presence of fixed data outside the screened collar that do not enter its inside. The seam tests and the selected cycle are those of the base process, without the insertion.
